title: The Broken Ember Anew
author: Cyrus Hartwell
blurb: Freya Thackeray, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
